evidence.establishes: Nintendo's official Time Patrol Support Pack listing names Power Pole Combo among the included Super Attacks.
Xbox's official product listing independently names Power Pole Combo among the included Super Attacks and notes that some content can be obtained through the in-game shop or specified conditions.
Dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill evidence identifies Power Pole Combo as a 100-Ki Strike Super used by Goku (GT), with seven-hit repeated-input behavior and tracking.

acquisition_boundary: The official Support Pack listings corroborate package provenance, but do not establish that the pack is the exclusive acquisition route. The repository therefore retains Skill Shop as the canonical acquisition endpoint.
limits: Exact frame, hitbox, damage, and input-window values remain unpromoted.
